facts.fact: Levellers says Burundi's personal data protection law of 10 March 2026 requires notice where personal data are processed with AI for automated decision-making and sets safeguards, including a human re-decision, for automated decisions with important effects.
Levellers says Burundi has no dedicated AI law or regulator as of its 8 June 2026 review; the 10 March 2026 data protection law is its main AI-relevant hard law.

BDI.note: No AI tool in a public sector system stated.
Says no published AI strategy; a workshop is groundwork for a future roadmap, with no drafting stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted locally is stated.

facts.fact: Levellers says the data protection law of 10 March 2026 creates a Personal Data Protection Agency but leaves its missions and organisation to a later decree, and no operational authority was identified.
